levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن عمر بن عبد العزيز

notes: the main route ends at عبد الله بن موهب; the saying «قال سألت رسول الله» follows the variant remark, so its speaker (Ibn Mawhab or Tamim al-Dari) is not settled by the text
«وقال بعضهم عن عبد الله بن وهب، عن تميم الداري» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
the Qabisa remark and «ليس بمتصل» are commentary, no transmitter
the Prophet is the end and is not written
